Nollywood actress, Adesua Etomi-Wellington, has revealed that she endured months of medical tests, hospital visits and uncertainty before doctors confirmed that she did not have cancer. In an emotional Instagram post on Friday, the actress described the period as one of the most difficult in her life, shedding light on her prolonged absence from social media and public appearances. She wrote, “2026 really tried it. I know I’ve been quieter than usual this year and that’s saying something, but behind the silence were some of the most difficult months of my life. Procedure after procedure. Test after test. Scans, needles, hospital visits and moments of uncertainty.” In a video shared on social media, the actress was seen on a video call with family members and close friends as she shared the result of a laboratory test. “The doctor just called me back with the result from the lab, no cancer… God is good,” she said. Although she did not disclose the exact condition doctors were investigating, Adesua expressed gratitude for coming through the experience. “This year threw everything at me but by the grace of God, I am NOT EASILY BROKEN. I cried, fled hotel when director demanded sex – Actress, Omeche Oko I battled suicidal thoughts in silence after sexual assault – Dieko Afolayan TAMPAN swears in new national executive “The storms were very real, but God remained our Rock. Even in the moments when I couldn’t see what He was doing, He never stopped carrying me. “There is so much more to this testimony, and God is still cooking, but I had to stop and share a small part of it,” she wrote. The actress appreciated the doctors, other health personnel, family members, friends, her husband and children for standing by her throughout the difficult period. She also announced a new single with her husband, Olubankole Wellington, popularly known as Banky W, titled On My Way. Adesua said the song had taken on a special meaning for the Wellington family, reminding them of their experience and giving them another reason to be grateful.
